mechanism: Betamethasone may increase amlodipine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing amlodipine efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause fluid retention and hypokalemia, with opposing effects on blood pressure control.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and serum potassium levels; adjust amlodipine dose if needed; consider potassium supplementation if betamethasone is used long-term.
